trigger: Human pasted the advertised universal guide command into a fresh chat. The client reported that /g was served as application/octet-stream and asked the human what to do with it instead of reincarnating the guide.
failures: Extensionless GitHub Pages bootstrap file was not a reliable human/AI web transport.
Guide bootstrap did not make bare invocation behavior explicit enough: recover AND perform one useful guide cycle immediately.
A human-facing bootstrap was advertised before a fresh-chat served-route canary proved that the client could consume it.
repairs: Replaced gh-pages extensionless g with g/index.html so the canonical human route is /g/ and is served as an HTML page by the Pages directory route.
Published GUIDE v1.2 with an explicit AI instruction: do not ask what the URL is for; reincarnate and execute one useful guide cycle immediately.
Replaced gh-pages extensionless wc with wc/index.html for the same transport reason; canonical worker route is /wc/.
Updated p.txt to advertise /g/ and /wc/ and the autonomous guide wake behavior.
new_rule: No fresh-chat bootstrap route is considered VERIFIED merely because its source file exists. Human-facing guide/worker entrypoints require a served-route fresh-chat canary that proves the client reads the instructions and takes the intended first action without human explanation.
remaining_gate: Open a completely fresh chat with only `PROMETEO → https://juanmanuelpm.github.io/prometeo/g/`. PASS only if it loads durable state and performs useful guide work rather than asking what the link means.
